meta.text: Walk through the solution. Step one: create the notebook, keep the default language as Python, and name it so its purpose is obvious. Step two: create an all-purpose cluster with a current LTS runtime, two workers, and an auto-stop timeout, then wait until its state reads Running. Step three: attach the notebook, run the Python cell to build a DataFrame and register it with createOrReplaceTempView, then run a %sql cell and a %scala cell against that very view.
